structure.title: Treatment of Swelling (Edema)
structure.summary: Management of swelling in CKD stage 3 through sodium restriction and diuretics.
structure.text: Patients with stage 3 CKD experiencing swelling (edema) should restrict sodium intake to less than 2g per day. High potassium foods like bananas should be monitored if eGFR is below 45. Diuretics like Furosemide are often prescribed under medical supervision.
